serverInfo.name: tradingview
serverInfo.description: AI-assisted TradingView chart analysis and Pine Script development via Chrome DevTools Protocol

server_info.instructions:
TradingView MCP — 78 tools for reading and controlling a live TradingView Desktop chart.

TOOL SELECTION GUIDE — use this to pick the right tool:

Reading your chart:
- chart_get_state → get symbol, timeframe, all indicator names + entity IDs (call first)
- data_get_study_values → get current numeric values from ALL visible indicators (RSI, MACD, BB, EMA, etc.)
- quote_get → get real-time price snapshot (last, OHLC, volume)
- data_get_ohlcv → get price bars. ALWAYS pass summary=true unless you need individual bars

Reading custom Pine indicator output (line.new/label.new/table.new/box.new drawings):
- data_get_pine_lines → horizontal price levels from custom indicators (deduplicated, sorted)
- data_get_pine_labels → text annotations with prices ("PDH 24550", "Bias Long", etc.)
- data_get_pine_tables → table data as formatted rows (session stats, analytics dashboards)
- data_get_pine_boxes → price zones as {high, low} pairs
- ALWAYS pass study_filter to target a specific indicator by name (e.g., study_filter="Profiler")
- Indicators must be VISIBLE on chart for these to work

Changing the chart:
- chart_set_symbol, chart_set_timeframe, chart_set_type → change ticker/resolution/style
- chart_manage_indicator → add/remove studies. USE FULL NAMES: "Relative Strength Index" not "RSI"
- chart_scroll_to_date → jump to a date (ISO format)
- indicator_set_inputs → change indicator settings (length, source, etc.)

Pine Script development:
- pine_set_source → inject code, pine_smart_compile → compile + check errors
- pine_get_errors → read errors, pine_get_console → read log output
- WARNING: pine_get_source can return 200KB+ for complex scripts — avoid unless editing

Screenshots: capture_screenshot → regions: "full", "chart", "strategy_tester"
Replay: replay_start → replay_step → replay_trade → replay_status → replay_stop
Batch: batch_run → run action across multiple symbols/timeframes
Drawing: draw_shape → horizontal_line, trend_line, rectangle, text
Alerts: alert_create, alert_list, alert_delete
Launch: tv_launch → auto-detect and start TradingView with CDP on any platform
Panes: pane_list, pane_set_layout (s, 2h, 2v, 4, 6, 8), pane_focus, pane_set_symbol
Tabs: tab_list, tab_new, tab_close, tab_switch

CONTEXT MANAGEMENT:
- ALWAYS use summary=true on data_get_ohlcv
- ALWAYS use study_filter on pine tools when you know which indicator you want
- NEVER use verbose=true unless user specifically asks for raw data
- Prefer capture_screenshot for visual context over pulling large datasets
- Call chart_get_state ONCE at start, reuse entity IDs

tools.name: morning_brief
tools.description: Scan your watchlist, read all indicator values, and return structured data for a session brief. Reads rules.json for your bias criteria and watchlist. Claude applies the rules to generate your daily bias.

tools.name: session_save
tools.description: Save today's morning brief to ~/.tradingview-mcp/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.json for future reference.

tools.name: session_get
tools.description: Retrieve a saved session brief. Returns today's if available, otherwise yesterday's.

tools.name: tv_state_snapshot
tools.description: Lab: snapshot chart symbol/timeframe, whether the Pine editor is open, Strategy Tester visibility, and any open modal.

tools.name: pine_detect_blocking_modal
tools.description: Lab: detect & classify any blocking TradingView modal (SAVE_SCRIPT_MODAL, UNSAVED_CHANGES_MODAL, PUBLISH_MODAL, LOGIN_MODAL, BROKER_OR_ORDER_MODAL, PAYMENT_OR_UPGRADE_MODAL, UNKNOWN_MODAL). Returns structured status, never clicks anything.

tools.name: pine_resolve_known_modal
tools.description: Lab: safely resolve ONLY a known+expected modal. Save Script confirmed only when name matches expected_script_name. Publish/login/broker/payment are always refused (UNSAFE_ACTION_REFUSED).

tools.name: pine_compile
tools.description: Lab: compile Pine source via TradingView pine-facade (server-side, no popup). Returns OK_COMPILED or COMPILE_ERROR with exact line/column errors. This is the reliable compile/validation path.

tools.name: pine_read_compile_errors
tools.description: Lab: compile source and return only the error list (line/column/message).

tools.name: pine_replace_script
tools.description: Lab: inject Pine source into the live Monaco editor (opens the Pine editor first; refuses if a blocking modal is up). Does NOT save or add to chart.

tools.name: pine_add_to_chart
tools.description: Lab: add the current editor script to the chart (foregrounds the Pine editor + modal preflight first). Clicks "Add to chart", or "Update on chart" when the script is already on chart — the latter autosaves the linked script and is reported via the warning/autosaved_linked_script fields. Pass allow_update_existing=false to refuse the update case instead.

tools.name: pine_save_script
tools.description: Lab: save current script (Ctrl+S). If the Save Script name dialog appears it is confirmed only when expected_script_name matches; otherwise refused.

tools.name: strategy_tester_read_summary
tools.description: Lab: read the Strategy Tester backtest summary (net profit, trades, % profitable, profit factor, max drawdown) from the chart model API. Returns STRATEGY_TESTER_NOT_AVAILABLE if no strategy is on the chart.

tools.name: pine_full_cycle_indicator
tools.description: Lab: full indicator cycle — compile (facade) → inject → optionally add to chart. Stops at COMPILE_ERROR with errors.

tools.name: pine_full_cycle_strategy
tools.description: Lab: full strategy cycle — compile (facade) → inject → add to chart → read Strategy Tester summary. add_to_chart defaults FALSE (adding can autosave over a linked saved script). Stops at COMPILE_ERROR with errors.

tools.name: live_trading_status
tools.description: LIVE: read the strict-gate status (enabled/disabled, factors, caps, time/orders remaining). Never reveals the confirm_token.

tools.name: live_broker_status
tools.description: LIVE: read-only — is a broker (e.g. Binance) connected in TradingView?

tools.name: live_place_order
tools.description: LIVE: preview (default) or submit a REAL broker order. dry_run defaults TRUE and sends nothing. A real submit (dry_run=false) requires the gate to be ARMED by a human PLUS confirm_token + i_understand_real_money=true, and is still capped by the armed whitelist/notional/budget. Refuses with a structured status otherwise.

tools.name: webhook_health
tools.description: LIVE: check the webhook bot is reachable (GET /test). Set env WEBHOOK_URL first.

tools.name: webhook_place_order
tools.description: LIVE: place an order ON COMMAND through the existing webhook bot (same endpoint TradingView alerts use). dry_run defaults TRUE (returns the exact JSON, sends nothing). A real send needs dry_run=false + the gate ARMED + confirm_token + i_understand_real_money=true, and respects the armed caps. Supports the bot payload: fixed_usd/fixed_qty/strategy/match_last, optional tp_price, LIMIT type/price.
